notes.title: BIG FIX PATCH
notes.content:
FIX PATCH
- Room 107 - Some players were stuck outside the room without being able to enter. -FIX
- The little girl appeared directly in her place after the call that concerns her. -FIX
No need to go around the map several times.
- Double spawn. -FIX
- "Clean the room" bugs. -FIX
- The jumpscare and screams are less loud.
- Partial support of the joystick (the mouse is only needed in the settings).
And the keys have been reallocated appropriately. -FIX
